name: C2PA Content Credentials
description: Checks for C2PA (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity) content credentials and provenance data. The C2PA standard provides cryptographic proof of content origin and edit history.
mechanism: Scans metadata for C2PA manifest markers (JUMBF, CBOR containers), checks for AI generation action declarations, and validates content provenance chain integrity.
parameters:
C2PA markers: content credentials, manifest store, JUMBF, CBOR
AI actions: c2pa.created, ai_generated, trainedAlgorithmicMedia
accuracy: Very High - 95%+ when C2PA data is present. Currently limited adoption.
source: C2PA Technical Specification 2.0, Content Authenticity Initiative (CAI)
